remarks.name: Aaron Levie
remarks.role: ceo box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
remarks.text:
Awesome day in terms of new model releases from both Deepseek and Grok. Both of these new model updates represent huge jumps in capability at insanely low costs. 

This is truly Jevons paradox for AI playing out. By bringing down the cost of AI, demand will continue to accelerate. When I talk to enterprises, they have vastly more use-cases for what they’d like agents to handle than generally what they’re able to budget for today. 

They want agents to scan their codebases for security issues. They want agents to review all their documents. They want agents to process information in a large portion of their workflows. And so on. When we bring down the cost of AI or drive up capability levels, it opens up all new use cases in the enterprises, which drives even greater demand.

This is also great for the applied AI layer. The more choice of models - especially those tuned for different types (or costs) of work - the more value there is in being at the layer that can route and optimize based on the task. Great for the entire stack right now.
remarks.translation: 从Deepseek和Grok发布新模型的角度来看，今天真是精彩的一天。这两次新模型更新都以极低的成本带来了能力上的巨大飞跃。这真正体现了AI领域的杰文斯悖论正在上演。通过降低AI的成本，需求将继续加速增长。当我与企业交流时，他们希望智能体处理的应用场景，远比他们目前预算所能覆盖的要多得多。他们希望智能体扫描代码库以查找安全问题。他们希望智能体审阅所有文档。他们希望智能体在很大一部分工作流程中处理信息。诸如此类。当我们降低AI的成本或提升能力水平时，就会在企业中开启全新的应用场景，从而推动更大的需求。这对应用AI层也非常有利。模型的选择越多——尤其是那些针对不同类型（或成本）工作调优的模型——处于能够根据任务进行路由和优化的那一层，其价值就越大。目前这对整个技术栈来说都是好事。
remarks.observation: 这条言论可作为 Agent 产品形态、协作方式或能力边界的观察入口；只代表公开观点，不作为公司事实主证据。

remarks.name: Madhu Guru
remarks.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
remarks.text:
I miss when teams actually whiteboarded. Sad casualty of the Covid wfh era.

There was something playful about standing around a board, drawing half-baked ideas, interrupting each other and jointly shaping things.

Years of Zoom and Google Meet seem to have beaten that instinct out of people.
remarks.translation: 我怀念团队真正在白板上写写画画的日子。这是新冠疫情居家办公时代一个令人遗憾的牺牲品。围站在白板旁，画出些半生不熟的想法，互相打断，共同塑造方案，那种感觉带着几分随性趣味。多年的Zoom和Google Meet似乎已经磨灭了人们这种本能。

remarks.text:
Running GBrain with Codex or Claude Code should be a *separate agent* and I wouldn't expect you to run it in your main coding agent.

Think of it more like a personal AI version of ChatGPT or Claude that has its own git repo for memory and custom skills.

remarks.name: Madhu Guru
remarks.role: Sr Director, AI at Meta; Prev: Google - Led Gemini, Veo, Nano Banana.
remarks.text:
The biggest alpha in AI products over the next few years is in the application layer.

Models will keep getting cheaper, better and more local.

The differentiation will come from deeply understanding specific user workflows and having the imagination to redesign the experience around them.

The denominator of people who can build AI products is about to get enormous.

So being in the top 0.1% of builders will matter more than ever.
remarks.translation: 未来几年，AI产品中最大的阿尔法收益将出现在应用层。模型会持续变得更便宜、更优秀、更本地化。差异化将源于对特定用户工作流程的深刻理解，以及围绕这些流程重新设计体验的想象力。能够构建AI产品的人群基数即将变得极其庞大。因此，跻身顶尖0.1%的构建者将比以往任何时候都更为关键。

remarks.name: Peter Yang
remarks.role: Practical AI tutorials and interviews for busy people
remarks.text:
I believe the way we use computers will soon change forever.

We’re moving from doing work manually with a keyboard, mouse, and laptop to directing agents in the cloud using our voices.

In my new essay, I cover why:

1. Voice is becoming the orchestration layer
2. Personal computers will move to the cloud
3. Trust will be the key differentiator

Read it here (it’s 100% free): https://t.co/cPvIqq0mge
remarks.translation: 我相信我们使用计算机的方式很快就会永远改变。我们正从用键盘、鼠标和笔记本电脑手动完成工作，转向用声音指挥云端中的智能代理。在我的新文章中，我阐述了原因：1. 语音正在成为编排层 2. 个人电脑将迁移到云端 3. 信任将成为关键差异化因素 在这里阅读（100%免费）：https://t.co/cPvIqq0mge
